stemMd: A geometric sequence has first term 3 and common ratio 2. What is the sum of its first five terms?
explanationMd: The first five terms are 3,6,12,24,48. Their sum is 93, also obtained from 3(2 to the fifth−1)/(2−1).

distractorRationale.b: This is only the fifth term.
distractorRationale.d: This is twice the fifth term rather than the five-term sum.
distractorRationale.a: This sums the first four terms.
